summary: Evaluate engineered tissue models as limited experimental systems with explicit biological and ethical boundaries.
outcomes: Compare scaffolds, organoids, microphysiological systems and biohybrid interfaces by question.
Assess maturation, reproducibility, vascularization and functional-validity limitations.
sequence: Define the tissue function being modeled
Map cells, scaffold and interface roles
Assess viability, maturation and batch variation
Design readouts of function rather than resemblance
Discuss donor consent and unresolved ethical questions

visual.question: Which feature of a nervous system does this model actually reproduce?
visual.interaction: Match fictional research claims to the measurements and missing features needed to support them.

practice.task: Critique an organoid-computing or repair claim from a supplied study packet.
practice.success: Separates demonstrated outcomes, proxy measures, speculation and required follow-up evidence.
